title: EviDQ: Experimental Reproducibility Package
description: Experimental reproducibility package accompanying the EviDQ research manuscript. The repository contains four case studies covering health data-quality governance, a simulated cancer registry, Beijing air-quality observations, and controlled missingness and intervention evaluation in diabetes data. It includes Jupyter notebooks, recorded experimental outputs, supporting research artifacts, and documentation of reproducibility limitations.
